description: This file implements certificate compression and decompression logic for QUIC protocol, including handling of certificate chains, zlib compression with custom dictionaries, and certificate hash matching.

classes.name: ScopedZLib
classes.description: Manages automatic cleanup of zlib inflate/deflate streams.

methods.name: MatchCerts
methods.description: Returns certificate entries indicating whether certs are cached or need compression.

methods.name: CertEntriesSize
methods.description: Calculates size of serialized certificate entries.

methods.name: SerializeCertEntries
methods.description: Serializes certificate entries into a byte buffer.

methods.name: ZlibDictForEntries
methods.description: Creates a zlib dictionary for decompressing certificate chains.

methods.name: HashCerts
methods.description: Computes FNV-1a hashes for a list of certificates.

methods.name: ParseEntries
methods.description: Parses serialized certificate entries from input buffer.

methods.name: CompressChain
methods.description: Compresses a chain of certificates into a zlib stream with custom dictionary.

methods.name: DecompressChain
methods.description: Decompresses a certificate chain from a zlib stream, resolving cached certificates.
